title: Shifted Koszul complex and its canonical affine augmentation
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $r\geq0$, and $f_1,\ldots,f_r\in A$. For the Koszul chain complex $K_\bullet(f)$ [def-weil-pbc-koszul-complex], define $I^{-n}=K_{n+1}$ for $n\geq0$, $I^i=0$ for $i>0$, and $d_I^{-n}=-d_{n+1}$ for $n>0$. The canonical augmentation $I^\bullet\to A[0]$ has degree-zero component $d_1:K_1\to K_0=A$ and zero components in all other degrees. On $X=\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ [def-pc-scheme], apply the associated sheaf functor degreewise and then localization to $D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category] to obtain $u:I\to\mathcal O_X$.
